You've spent a sufficient amount of time banned, you seem to have learned your lesson, and last but not least, you don't show any suspicious activity regarding ban evasion, so I will be giving you one last chance and accepting your appeal. Hopefully you've changed and don't misbehave any longer. Abide by the rules and you will have no problem.

Sincerely,
